name: Rattlesnake Scale Armor
body:
Aura: moderate necromancy and transmutation; CL 7th; Slot: chest; Price: 9,000 gp, Weight: 15 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This armor is made from the scales of huge rattlesnakes. It is equivalent to masterwork leather armor, but also gives the wearer a +2 enhancement bonus on saves vs. poison, a +2 enhancement bonus on Stealth checks and the ability to cast cause fear (caster level 7, Will DC 14) against one opponent within 5 ft., once per day, as a supernatural ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells cause fear, delay poison, invisibility, silence; Cost: 4,500 gp.
